pages.title: Annecy
pages.extract: Annecy, in the north of the French Alps, is called "the Venice of Savoie" — a well-deserved title. The medieval town centre built around a 14th-century chateau is dissected by small canals and streams running out of Lac Annecy, which is clean, fresh and a wonderful azure colour. Annecy is the prefecture of the département of Haute-Savoie.

pages.extract: Ertholmene is a group of small islands north-east of Bornholm.

pages.title: Hovd
pages.extract: Jyrgalant is the capital of the Hovd province of Mongolia. By extension it is directly named Khovd or Hovd (Mongolian: Ховд). It has a population of around 30,000. Note that there is a different village close to it that has this name.

pages.title: Moundsville
pages.description: city in Marshall County, West Virginia, United States
pages.extract: Moundsville, West Virginia, is a city in Ohio Valley. It is the county seat of Marshall County.

pages.title: Na Meo
pages.extract: Na Meo (also spelt Na Maew) is a border town in Thanh Hoa Province, in the Central Coast (Vietnam) region of Vietnam, adjacent to Nam Xoi in Laos.

pages.title: Nyika National Park
pages.extract: Nyika National Park is a national park in Malawi, right next to the Nyika Plateau National Park in Zambia. With 3200 km² it is Malawi's biggest national park.

pages.title: Oklahoma City/Northeast
pages.description: human settlement in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, United States of America
pages.extract: The Northeast district of Oklahoma City includes the Paseo Arts District and the Adventure District.  Located at the crossroads of Interstate 35 and Interstate 44, the Adventure District includes seven attractions and two restaurants within an area that is just slightly smaller than two square miles.

pages.title: Rum Cay
pages.extract: Rum Cay is an island in the Bahamas. Deep reefs and drop-offs surround this former pirates’ haven.

pages.title: Queimada dos Britos
pages.extract:
Queimada dos Britos is a tiny settlement in an oasis of Lencois Maranhenses. It sits a few kilometers off the straight line between Atins and Santo Amaro, and somewhat nearer the latter, about 7 km to the northwest of its smaller neighbour, Baixa Grande.

Queimada dos Britos is in the state of Maranhão.

pages.title: Ice Age Trail
pages.description: long-distance hiking trail in the United States
pages.extract: The Ice Age National Scenic Trail is a hiking trail in Wisconsin, United States of America. It presents traces of the Ice Age in the form of different geological features.

pages.title: Ternate (Cavite)
pages.description: municipality of the Philippines in the province of Cavite
pages.extract:
For other places by the name, see Ternate (disambiguation).
Ternate is a municipality in Cavite, at the boundary with Batangas. Its name derives from the island of Ternate, one of the Spice Islands (present day Maluku in Indonesia). Some of the Christianized natives from that island settled here after volunteering with the Spanish, who immediately left their garrison on Ternate.
Nearby Maragondon is a small town just about 2 km (1.2 mi) away. Maragondon used to be the premier town of southwestern Cavite, with Ternate, Bailen and Magallanes previously among its barrios (today called barangays), but despite its historical contributions, Maragondon is nowadays overshadowed by Ternate, with its many beach resorts and bus terminal. Wikivoyage treats Maragondon as part of Ternate although it is governed separately, as their town centers are in close proximity.

pages.title: Diving the Cape Peninsula and False Bay/Blue Flame Reef
pages.extract: The dive site Blue Flame Reef also known as Blue Flame Pinnacles is an offshore rocky reef in the Off-Whittle Northern Reefs area of False Bay near Cape Town in the Western Cape Province of South Africa.

pages.title: Ciudad de la Paz
pages.extract: Ciudad de la Paz, previously known as Djibloho or Oyala, is the new capital of Equatorial Guinea, on the mainland in Río Muni, having replaced Malabo on 2 January 2026.

pages.title: Bangkok to Singapore overland
pages.extract: Travelling from Bangkok to Singapore in Southeast Asia, or vice versa, takes you across a journey over the Malay peninsula, and lets you see three countries in one go: Thailand, Malaysia, and Singapore.

pages.title: Kishangarh
pages.description: city in Ajmer district, Ajmer division, Rajasthan, India
pages.extract: Kishangarh (किशनगढ़ Kiśangaṛh) is a town near Ajmer, in central Rajasthan. Founded in 1609-1611 by Kishan Singh, the town is home to the Rathore clan of the Rajputs, as well as the marble slurry dumping yard turned into a snow-themed park.
